t: Brushless twin pack consisting of percussion drill and impact driver. Compact percussion drill delivers high power efficiency under load with up to 158Nm torque. Extremely compact design: 175mm length for access into tight spaces. Over-rotation is prevented by the Autostop Control Mode. Features 13mm metal chuck for quick bit changes and bit retention, bright LED work light, fuel gauge display and all-metal reversible belt clip. Compact impact driver provides high power efficiency under load delivering up to 226Nm torque and 4400ipm. Extremely compact design total length of just 113mm for access into tight spaces. Drive Control feature enables user to shift into 4 different speed and torque settings to maximise application versatility. Includes a 1/4" hex chuck for quick and easy bit changes. Both tools provide individual battery cell monitoring which optimises tool run time and ensures durability. Flexible battery system: works with all Milwaukee M18 batteries.
